QuestInfo.name: Making Mastery Medicine
QuestInfo.0: The resident pharmacist of #b#m250000000##k, #b#p2091002##k, seems to be in the midst of creating a special medicine...
QuestInfo.1:
#p2091002#, who claims to be working on a medicine that'll take a regular person much closer to becoming a Master, requested that I gather up the ingredients for him. The ingredients required are: #b10 #t4000288#s#k, #b10 #t4000292#s, 10 #t4000294#s, 6 #t4000281#s, and 4 #t4000283#s#k...

#i4000288##t4000288#  #b#c4000288##k/10   
#i4000292##t4000292#  #b#c4000292##k/10   
#i4000294##t4000294#  #b#c4000294##k/10   
#i4000281##t4000281#  #b#c4000281##k/6     
#i4000283##t4000283#  #b#c4000283##k/4
QuestInfo.2: I managed to give #p2091002# all the required ingredients. It actually looks good enough to be a medicine to speed up the recovery from, say, fatigue, but will this really make us become Masters?

0.0: For you to step foot here in #m250000000#, you must be interested in one day becoming a true Master. The path towards becoming one, however, is long and treacherous. There are a lot of people that have spent countless years training to become one, only to fall short. This is why I'm creating this medicine, to create new opportunities for others to become true Masters themselves. What do you think? Are you interested in one?

yes.0: The name of the medicine is #t2022143#. It's a special medicine that allows one to become much closer towards becoming a Master. I got most of the ingredients here, but I am lacking some. If you can gather those up for me, then I'll be more than happy to share the medicine with you.
yes.1: The ingredients I couldn't find are 10 #t4000288#s, 6 #t4000292#s, 10 #t4000294#s, 6 #t4000281#s, and 4 #t4000283#s. All I need are those, and I'll be able to make the incredible #t2022143#! Now go on, gather up those ingredients as fast as you can!

no.0: You're not interested? You're not interested in becoming a true Master? You don't fit the mold of a resident here in #m250000000#...
